name: oss
description: Open Science Skills (oss). 42 Claude Code skills for experimental social science and computational text analysis (including fable-orchestrate and opus-orchestrate, general multi-model orchestration workflows led by Fable 5 or by Opus 5; advisor, a single independent-second-reviewer consult in which the calling session holds the main seat on Opus 5 or Sonnet 5 while Fable 5 holds the advisor seat at max reasoning effort; and spawn, full peer Claude Code sessions in their own git worktrees and terminal panes — herdr, tmux, or claude background agents — briefed by contract, monitored, and merged back by the spawning lead). Research-repository scaffolding and auditing organized around a sources/ knowledge base (research-repo); conjoint design, diagnostics, and data cleaning; survey design; list experiments; cross-national design; topic modeling; LLM text classification; VLM-based OCR pipelines and OCR system comparison/evaluation (CER/WER); post-OCR cleanup; independent model-council voting and inter-rater agreement; a deliberative GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra) and Claude Opus 5 model committee at pinned reasoning effort, with a selectable chair — Opus 5 by default, or Fable 5, or GPT-5.6 Sol (model-committee, invoked by /model-committee, /model-committee-fable, or /model-committee-sol); LLM calibration via token log-probabilities; FAIR manuscript checks; citation checking; source-claim fact-checking; literature review evidence mapping; figure design; table design; house-style LaTeX paper formatting from any draft, with a tested convert-and-build driver (paper-tex); figure/table auditing; replication-package scaffolding (FAIR + Horiuchi conventions); paper pre-submission review (single-model and cross-model Claude+Codex variants); hypothesis building; narrative building; research-wayfinder decision-map study planning that outlives single sessions (adapted from Matt Pocock's wayfinder); pre-registration; methods reporting; presubmit activation; third-party journal review; and creative-divergence brainstorming in single-model and cross-model Claude+Codex variants (diverge, diverge-codex). Invoke as /oss:skill-name (or just /skill-name when there is no ambiguity) or let Claude auto-trigger based on context.
